step1.title: Web Fragments: Micro-Frontends Done Right?

chapters.title: Web Fragments - Micro Frontends Done Right

step1.description:
I've always been skeptical of Micro-Frontend technology. Calling it a necessary evil. But the developers from Cloudflare have been working on a radical approach, Web Fragments, that might just sway my opinion.

Igor Minar and Natalia Venditto join me and special guest Tanner Linsley to talk about the realities of growing applications to the largest scale.

Github: https://github.com/web-fragments/web-fragments
Signup for early adopters: https://forms.gle/qBHc67iuqbgXjyqm8

React Server Components Performance Article: https://www.developerway.com/posts/react-server-components-performance
